title: FIPS证据边界：真实算法提供者与模块验证范围
answer: “FIPS compliant”需要具体标准、模块、版本、运行模式及验证范围，不能仅因使用 AES 或开启一个开关就宣称通过。密码模块验证通常要查 CMVP 证书和安全策略，确认部署与验证配置一致；算法验证与整个模块验证不是同一件事。
review_note: Author draft: full original conceptual goal with real library/CLI counterexamples; current-source native matrix/non-author/batch gates pending. Not actualFIPScertification.
body:
## 原始完整要求
“符合 FIPS”意味着什么？
依据题目给出的前提作答，说明原理、适用条件及验证方法。参考答案为文本审校内容；涉及操作的示例仅用于获准的隔离环境，不代表已在生产执行。
原参考语义：“FIPS compliant”需要具体标准、模块、版本、运行模式及验证范围，不能仅因使用 AES 或开启一个开关就宣称通过。密码模块验证通常要查 CMVP 证书和安全策略，确认部署与验证配置一致；算法验证与整个模块验证不是同一件事。
## 操作任务与产物
交付单文件 fips_review.py，导出review(evidence)，只读证据返回下述字典。FIPS是标准族，本题是FIPS140密码模块证据场景。仅读取真实OpenSSL3.0.13 CLI与libcrypto，在自建非默认OSSL_LIB_CTX内观察default/base；不安装、激活已验证FIPS模块，不更改系统配置或全局库上下文。本题目标是正确区分观测与认证证据，参考通过不代表实验主机通过FIPS验证。

先执行真实原生观察：随机64字节输入，default提供者SHA256成功；要求fips=yes的SHA256在该私有上下文不可用。base提供者能列出带fips=yes属性的非密码编码器，但没有SHA256。另一自建上下文设置默认属性fips=yes后，显式局部属性选择仍实际取到default的SHA256。通过EVP_MD_get0_provider/OSSL_PROVIDER_get0_name记录真实算法实现来源、摘要和flag；这是受控非默认上下文，不能把它叫做全局配置变更或已验证批准模式。原生结果和清理先完成，再加载学生文件；观察器用-I及独立teacher目录，不从学生目录寻找同名原生助手。

证书事实采用2026-11-02读取的CMVP4985资料快照：FIPS140-3、OpenSSL FIPS Provider3.1.2、安全策略规定的批准模式及部署范围。来源见references与材料。它不是本机模块证书绑定，也不是今后状态保证；必须区分CAVP算法验证、CMVP模块验证，不能根据算法可用、属性开关或整套OpenSSL库版本宣称模块/整机合规。库版本与单独验证的provider版本可以不同，是否受厂商支持另需证据。NIST原件直接下载403记录保留，事实由可读官方网页核对并明确为人工转录快照，不伪造原HTML/PDF原件SHA。

evidence.native含原生commands（label、argv、returncode、stdout_original/stderr_original={bytes,sha256,base64}）、input_original、contexts及实际库版本。contexts依次是default无默认属性、base无默认属性、default且私有默认属性fips=yes；每项actual_default_fips_flag为原生int0/1，fetches依次plain/require_fips/explicit_default_override，每项fetched、可选selected_provider及digest_hex来自真实EVP操作。CLI label为providers_default/providers_base、base_fips_property_encoders、default_SHA256、default_require_fips_SHA256等。provider列表按两空格ID、四空格name/version/status解析，嵌套gettable参数不是新provider。

evidence.paper_cases为明确derived纸面条件视图，不是FIPS模块运行。每项case、policy、claim、origin。policy字段id/program/standard/module_name/provider_version须非空白字符串，standard仅本题密码模块FIPS140-2或140-3；claim的certificate_id对应policy.id，其余身份字段同名精确匹配，program必须CMVP，status_at_snapshot须Active；approved_mode/oe_covered/integrity_reviewed/base_library_supported须恰为bool True，False/None/整数1均不能充当已核验。base_library_version不充当provider_version，也不能据其字符串擅自推出支持状态。即使纸面条件相符，也不产生真实运行或整个系统的验证声明。Historical只是本题纸面条件不满足Active，不泛称其在所有场景非法。

## 验收方法
review返回恰有input_sha256；observed_contexts（原顺序，每项requested_provider、actual_default_fips_flag、selected_providers三项列表、digest_hex三项列表、scope_is_actual_private_probe=True、certificate4985_live_validation_proven=False）；cli_providers（两provider label映射至按原顺序{id,name,version,status}列表）；default_digest_returncode、require_fips_digest_returncode；base_noncrypto_fips_property_encoders（stdout中同时含@ base和fips=yes的行数，严格int）；encoder_property_proves_module_validation=False；algorithm_validation_equals_module_validation=False；document_scope（原顺序case、conditional_scope_match(bool)、origin=explicit_derived_paper_scope、live_validation_proven=False）；whole_system_fips_compliance_proven=False。

验证正解、合法解析替代、错误证据推断、遗漏验证边界、未完成/提前退出及输入不被修改。每轮保留CLI原始输入输出、PID/starttime/退出、实际C API来源和摘要、所有纸面输入与比较；所有EVP对象/provider/私有context释放、子进程回收、临时配置目录删除、FD/线程/原配置与全局flag前后不变。当前精确源需非作者复核及合批导入/seed/API/幂等/旧题兼容，完整模块门禁交会话10。

review是仅依传入数据的纯函数。可导入base64/hashlib/re/json/collections/itertools/functools/operator/typing/dataclasses/math/copy/statistics/heapq/datetime/binascii/decimal/fractions/numbers/unicodedata；禁止teacher导入、文件/进程/网络I/O、动态exec/eval/import和解释器内部属性。检查公开依赖约束及代表性投机路径，不宣称Python通用安全沙箱。
rubric: 核心概念与因果关系准确
前提、限制和验证方式与题意一致

exercise.environment: Fixed WSL student1000, actual OpenSSL3.0.13 CLI/libcrypto private nondefault contexts; no validatedprovider installation or hostcompliance assertion

import base64,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,signal,subprocess,sys,traceback,zlib
pins=json.loads(pathlib.Path('checks/tools.json').read_text())
def hashes():return {path:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()for path in pins}
def state():
 def digest(path):
  path=pathlib.Path(path);return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()if path.is_file()else None
 return dict(uid=os.getuid(),gid=os.getgid(),PATH=os.environ.get('PATH'),netns=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net'),userns=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/user'),links=hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['/usr/sbin/ip','-j','link'])).hexdigest(),routes=hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['/usr/sbin/ip','-j','route','show','table','all'])).hexdigest(),hosts=digest('/etc/hosts'),resolv=digest('/etc/resolv.conf'),kube=digest(pathlib.Path.home()/'.kube/config'),goenv=digest(pathlib.Path.home()/'.config/go/env'))
before=state();tools=hashes();assert before['uid']==before['gid']==1000 and tools==pins,'NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: fixed student and pinned real tools required'
record=dict(outer_before=before,tool_sha256_before=tools,passed=False);process=None
try:
 command=['/usr/bin/unshare','--user','--map-user=1000','--map-group=1000','--keep-caps','--net',sys.executable,'-I','-B','checks/fips_worker.py']
 process=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
 try:stdout,stderr=process.communicate(timeout=25)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL);stdout,stderr=process.communicate(timeout=5);record['outer_timeout']=True
 record.update(command=command,exit_code=process.returncode,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,own_worker_reaped=process.poll()is not None)
 path=pathlib.Path('checks/fips-inner-evidence.json')
 if path.is_file():
  raw=path.read_bytes();assert len(raw)<=67108864
  record.update(native_zlib_base64=base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(raw,9)).decode(),native_uncompressed_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),native_uncompressed_bytes=len(raw))
  native=json.loads(raw);record['native_passed']=native.get('passed')
 assert process.returncode==0 and record.get('native_passed'),'actual OpenSSL evidence-boundary review failed: '+stdout+stderr
 record['passed']=True
except BaseException:record['failure']=traceback.format_exc();raise
finally:
 if process is not None and process.poll()is None:os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL);process.communicate(timeout=5)
 record.update(outer_after=state(),tool_sha256_after=hashes())
 assert before==record['outer_after']and tools==record['tool_sha256_after']
 data=json.dumps(record,separators=(',',':')).encode();assert len(data)<=16777216
 pathlib.Path('checks/native-evidence.json').write_bytes(data)
 print('NATIVE_FIPS_SCOPE_EVIDENCE_FILE:'+json.dumps(dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),bytes=len(data),passed=record['passed'])))
test_files.checks/fips_worker.py:
import ast,copy,hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,pathlib,resource,sys,threading,traceback
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')];resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))
def fds():return len(list(pathlib.Path('/proc/self/fd').iterdir()))
record=dict(passed=False,completion_credit=0,fd_before=fds(),thread_before=threading.active_count())
try:
 import trusted_review
 from fips_native import run
 run(record);assert record['passed'],'Actual private libcrypto/CLI observations failed'
 policy=json.loads(pathlib.Path('checks/policy-snapshot.json').read_text())['certificate']
 base=dict(standard=policy['standard'],program='CMVP',certificate_id=policy['id'],module_name=policy['module_name'],provider_version=policy['provider_version'],approved_mode=True,oe_covered=True,integrity_reviewed=True,base_library_supported=True,base_library_version=record['openssl_library_version'])
 cases=[]
 def add(label,claim=None,paper=None):cases.append(dict(case=label,claim=copy.deepcopy(claim or base),policy=copy.deepcopy(paper or policy),origin='explicit_derived_paper_scope'))
 add('matching_scope_assumptions_not_live_attestation')
 other=dict(base,base_library_version='Different supported base library, not provider identity');add('base_library_not_provider_version',other)
 for field,value in [('standard','FIPS'),('program','CAVP'),('certificate_id','different-id'),('module_name','different module'),('provider_version','different provider version')]:add('mismatch_'+field,dict(base,**{field:value}))
 add('algorithm_records_not_module_validation',dict(base,program='CAVP'),dict(policy,program='CAVP'))
 add('unspecified_standard_on_both_sides',dict(base,standard='FIPS'),dict(policy,standard='FIPS'))
 add('whitespace_module_identity',dict(base,module_name=' '),dict(policy,module_name=' '))
 for field in ('approved_mode','oe_covered','integrity_reviewed','base_library_supported'):
  for label,value in [('false',False),('unknown',None),('integer',1)]:add(field+'_'+label,dict(base,**{field:value}))
 add('historical_paper_not_active',paper=dict(policy,status_at_snapshot='Historical'))
 for field in ('id','program','standard','module_name','provider_version'):
  missing=dict(policy);missing.pop(field);claim=dict(base)
  if field=='id':claim.pop('certificate_id')
  else:claim.pop(field)
  add('missing_policy_and_claim_'+field,claim,missing)
 record['paper_input_original']=copy.deepcopy(cases);evidence=dict(native=copy.deepcopy(record),paper_cases=cases)
 text=(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'fips_review.py').read_text();record['submitted_source_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest();tree=ast.parse(text)
 allowed={'base64','hashlib','re','json','collections','itertools','functools','operator','typing','dataclasses','math','copy','statistics','heapq','datetime','binascii','decimal','fractions','numbers','unicodedata'}
 for node in ast.walk(tree):
  if isinstance(node,ast.Import):assert all(alias.name.split('.')[0]in allowed for alias in node.names),'Data-review contract: unsupported/teacher import'
  if isinstance(node,ast.ImportFrom):assert node.level==0 and node.module and node.module.split('.')[0]in allowed,'Data-review contract: unsupported/teacher import'
  if isinstance(node,ast.Call)and isinstance(node.func,ast.Name):assert node.func.id not in {'open','exec','eval','compile','__import__','globals','locals','getattr','setattr','vars','input','breakpoint'},'Data-review contract: dynamic execution or external IO'
  if isinstance(node,ast.Attribute):assert not node.attr.startswith('__'),'Data-review contract: interpreter internals'
 record['data_review_contract_checked']=True
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('student_fips_review',pathlib.Path.cwd()/'fips_review.py');fips_review=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules[spec.name]=fips_review;sys.modules['fips_review']=fips_review;spec.loader.exec_module(fips_review)
 before=copy.deepcopy(evidence);actual=fips_review.review(evidence);assert evidence==before,'Review modified original observation or paper input';expected=trusted_review.review(before)
 record.update(paper_cases=cases,reported_review=actual,expected_review=expected)
 assert json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))==json.dumps(expected,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')),'Review differs from real provider/digest observation or explicit paper scope'
except BaseException:record['passed']=False;record['worker_failure']=traceback.format_exc()
finally:
 record.update(fd_after=fds(),thread_after=threading.active_count());record['passed']=record['passed']and record['fd_before']==record['fd_after']and record['thread_before']==record['thread_after'];pathlib.Path('checks/fips-inner-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,separators=(',',':')))
assert record['passed'],'Actual FIPS evidence-boundary review failed; original records retained'
